excerpt: Set clear writing tasks and review each student’s progress as they work.

Review writing progress and open submitted essays. Status reflects saved student work only. Stage revisions count changes between saved revisions; the first saved text for a stage is its starting version. Estimated Active Writing Time comes from recorded editing activity; about 60 seconds without editing ends an activity period. “No recorded data” is not the same as measured zero time.
